visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short blonde hair, wearing a brown turtleneck and a dark grey floral pinafore, stands inside a bright retail store filled with stationery shelves. She holds a grey plastic shopping basket containing various pens and notebooks. The lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene shifts to a product display featuring numerous double-ended highlighter pens in pastel colors. The woman’s hand reaches out to select a pen. The background shows organized shelves with Japanese text on signage. (3) A hand is shown in a close-up, demonstrating a pink highlighter on a white sheet of paper. The hand draws perfectly straight lines. Then, the other end of the pen is used to write small text and draw a heart. (4) The hand then demonstrates a blue highlighter used alongside a silver ruler on white paper. The ink appears to dry instantly without smearing. (5) The woman holds four highlighters in her hand to show their varied pastel colors. (6) The focus shifts to clear acrylic stamps with animal and geometric designs. A hand presses a tiger-faced stamp onto a sheet of paper. (7) A hand uses different colored inks with the clear stamp to create a layered, three-dimensional effect of a tiger's face. (8) A wooden stamp labeled 'TO DO LIST' is pressed into a leather-bound planner, creating a neat checklist. (9) A close-up shows a small yellow chick-shaped eraser in its packaging. Then, a hand picks up two sleek light-colored ballpoint pens from a display. (10) Screenshots of a brochure or website with lists of winners and product photos are displayed. (11) The woman reappears, holding a yellow LOFT shopping bag and her basket. Finally, she is seen at a table with a man and a small child, playing with a toy train set in a brightly lit indoor play area.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 2025年日本文具大賞結果出來了! (2) [Subtitle]: 今天跟大家分享2個得獎選手. [Variety]: 文具年度大賞. (3) [Subtitle]: PILOT百樂雙頭螢光筆. (4) [Subtitle]: 再也不會因為線畫不直煩躁了. (5) [Subtitle]: 筆尖兩端有透明固定模板. (6) [Subtitle]: 柔軟筆芯能緊密貼合紙張. (7) [Subtitle]: 照著畫就能輕鬆畫出直線. (8) [Subtitle]: 不是平面也很順. (9) [Subtitle]: 另一端還可以寫字. (10) [Subtitle]: 用尺畫線也不會弄髒尺. (11) [Subtitle]: 選用速乾墨水不暈染原本的筆跡. (12) [Subtitle]: 顏色清新舒服選擇也很多喔. (13) [Subtitle]: 創意獎 HITOTOKI 冰塊透明印章. (14) [Subtitle]: 透明設計蓋印章時更好瞄準位置. (15) [Subtitle]: 還可以用不同墨水蓋出3D立體感. (16) [Subtitle]: 尺寸和圖案都很豐富. (17) [Subtitle]: 還有出很多套組可以一次收集. (18) [Subtitle]: 另外我還很推薦這個印章. (19) [Subtitle]: 蓋在手帳上就可以輕鬆寫to do list. (20) [Subtitle]: 其他還有越擦越可愛的橡皮擦. (21) [Subtitle]: 減少阻力寫起來更流暢更好握的圓珠筆. (22) [Subtitle]: 滿滿的創意實用文具. (23) [Subtitle]: 搜尋2025年日本文具大賞就可以看到. (24) [Subtitle]: 你最喜歡哪一個呢. (25) [Subtitle]: 趕快傳給文具控的朋友吧. (26) [Subtitle]: 我是在東京育兒的RU醬. (27) [Subtitle]: 追蹤我看更多日本生活和最新日本情報.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful, high-pitched female voice speaks in fast Mandarin, introducing the stationery awards. Upbeat, synthesized pop background music with a steady electronic drum beat plays at a moderate volume. The vocals are clear and enunciated. (2) As the video cuts to product demonstrations, the narrator's pace remains energetic. Short, high-frequency 'pop' and 'bubble' sound effects are added to emphasize text appearing on screen. The BGM maintains a consistent major-key melody. (3) Subtle scratching sounds of a pen writing on paper are audible under the narration, matched with the visual of drawing lines. (4) A metallic click or sliding sound accompanies the use of the ruler. The BGM's synth bass becomes more prominent. (5) The narrator's tone shifts to excitement while describing the 'creative award' winner. Another 'ding' SFX sounds as a new brand name is mentioned. (6) Soft, percussive thudding sounds are synchronized with the hand pressing the stamps onto the paper. (7) The final phase features the narrator concluding with a friendly invitation to follow her, with the BGM fading out slightly to emphasize her closing words. Faint laughter or a child's babble is momentarily heard in the very last second.
